_note: Strings for the computed cataloguer questions — see app/src/catalog/slots.js and docs/Utsav/Product_Questions.md. `catalog.q_what` is deliberately re-worded over the copy in en.json/hi.json: it is now the one broad question the others are harvested from, so it has to invite a sentence rather than a noun. The _new_*.json files are folded in after the base bundles, so this override is the intended mechanism, not a collision. Odia is absent on purpose — an unreviewed Odia draft spoken to someone who cannot read it is worse than the English fallback resolve() already gives. Add `or` only after a native speaker has checked it.

en.catalog.q_what: Tell me about this. What is it?
en.catalog.q_stock: How many of these do you have?
en.catalog.q_lead_time: How many days do you need to get it ready?
en.catalog.confirm_same: Last time you said {value}. Same this time?
en.catalog.weight_hint: Put it on a scale if you have one. A guess is fine.
en.catalog.stock_hint: If you make each one to order, say one.

hi.catalog.q_what: इसके बारे में बताइए। यह क्या है?
hi.catalog.q_lead_time: तैयार करने में कितने दिन लगेंगे?
hi.catalog.confirm_same: पिछली बार आपने {value} कहा था। इस बार भी वही?
hi.catalog.weight_hint: तराज़ू हो तो तौल लीजिए। अंदाज़ा भी चलेगा।
hi.catalog.stock_hint: अगर ऑर्डर पर बनाते हैं तो एक कहिए।
